page.overview:
What is Bliking?

The Bliking is Wapol's submersible attack ship.

The Bliking is a large round ship, different than most regular ships. Along with the ship's White Walkie figure head, one of the ship's unique features is the large steel plating around the ship, with a star like pattern. Two large gears are seen towards the side of the ship.

While trying to return to Drum Island, the Bliking crossed paths with the Going Merry. Wapol had the ship surface so they could acquire a Log Pose or Eternal Pose to Drum Island from the Straw Hat Pirates; however, the Straw Hats did not have one for the island. After Monkey D. Luffy launched Wapol off the Merry, the Bliking Pirates returned to their ship and rushed off to save the king before he could drown.

After successfully saving Wapol, they eventually found their way to the island. The ship docked on the coast, and the Bliking Pirates disembarked and defeated the citizens who tried to stop them.
